title: Single-cell variant-to-enhancer-to-gene map for coronary artery disease
description:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11275-z

A multi-omic gene-expression and chromatin-accessibility map of human coronary artery disease provides a framework for mapping disease-associated genetic variants to cell types, chromatin states and gene programmes in human disease.
